```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(11)
n=nrow(fantasy2025)
s=sample(n,0.7*n)
train=fantasy2025[s,]
test=fantasy2025[-s,]

library(class)
fit_knn=knn(train[,c("carries","targets")], # training predictors
            test[,c("carries","targets")],  # test predictors
            cl=train$RB,                    # training outcomes
            k=11)                           # number of neighbors
head(fit_knn)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] N N N N N Y
Levels: N Y
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
accuracy=sum(fit_knn==test$RB)/nrow(test)
cat("Accuracy = ",accuracy)
```

